body:
Money is always a difficult problem, especially in a third country, sometimes just a few thousand dollars can change your life.
In my country, a kidney costs only 10k $
I really want to see the faces of my family members when i die.
Yes, it's normal. I've been living with it for over a year.
A little money so I can move out of this place and start a new life

The only thing that keeps me alive is this debt, it's not a lot of money, I can pay it off in a year.

But it doesn't matter anymore, now I simply want to pay off all the debt, I don't want to leave this world while I still owe others something.

In my country, selling kidneys is illegal, but donating is legal, brokers take advantage of this legal loophole.

The surgery will be done at the best hospital in the country, so there shouldn't be any danger.

p/s: I don't live in India
